content:
Hello, I'm brand new to lean and am running into some issues on win 11 in helix (hx) and vscode both

When I generate a new project with "lake new foo", attempting to import "Foo.Basic", or any lean file in that directory will cause the language server analysis to fail with "Unknown Module Prefix Foo". This means I cannot analyze e.g. the autogenerated templates, which use this structure.

It's basically the exact same issue as this: https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113489-new-members/topic/How.20to.20add.20more.20files.20to.20build.3F/near/563639552

Lake build works intermittently; sometimes it builds without an error, sometimes it fails to build with the same error as the lsp. To the best of my ability, I have:

Uninstalled and reinstalled all toolchains
Attempted on multiple nightly version, as well as stable
Attempted to generate a project with a variety of options (e.g. lib only, exe only, toml, lean)

Nothing works; occasionally there is a regression - this is when lake build begins to fail. Thereafter, the only thing I have been able to do to get lake build to work again is to garbage collect and reinstall all the lean toolchain. Thereafter, lake build works again, but the LSP continues to return the same error. Anyone have an idea what this might be?

hx --health lean

Toolchain: leanprover/lean4-nightly:nightly-2026-06-04 (also attempted toolchains dated beginning 6/1), stable
Editors: Helix 24.07, VSCode 1.123.0

Actually, now after uninstalling all toolchains + elan and reinstalling, now lake build doesnt work either:

This is the identical error message I get when using the language server.

I now receive the error "binary package was not provided for 'windows' whenever I invoke the language server or compiler. I was formerly able to compile single files so long as they had not imports . I had made no changes to my environment other than reinstalling elan.
